v-s35.condition: Unit 2, Test yourself V, с. 35. Напиши письмо в газету на тему «Часто ли ты пользуешься интернетом?».
steps: Dear editor, I like using the Internet. I can read something interesting and useful. I can play computer games and chat with friends. But I follow the safety rules: I never give my name and address to strangers. I use the Internet for an hour a day. Alex, 11.
v-s35.answer: Письмо о пользовании интернетом и правилах безопасности

vi-s36.condition: Unit 2, Test yourself VI, с. 36. Как много ты знаешь о британской культуре? Выбери правильные ответы.
steps: B, B, A, A.

vii-s36.condition: Unit 2, Test yourself VII, с. 36. Изучи лексику и ответь на вопросы.
steps: When I talk about safety I use such words as permission, to care about, cautious of, danger, to follow rules, a stranger.
When I talk about chores I use: to sweep the floor, to look after pets, to help about the house, to do the washing-up.
vii-s36.answer: Слова о безопасности и о домашних обязанностях

viii-s36.condition: Unit 2, Test yourself VIII, с. 36 (AB IV, с. 30). Оцени себя.
steps: I can talk about rules with must, have to, should. I can say what I'm sure about with must and what I'm not sure about with may/might. I can invite a friend: How about going to …? I need to practise mustn't / don't have to.

1-s38.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 38. Клуб «Willing Helpers». 1) Что могли бы делать дети? 2) Что они собираются делать? 3) Что ты думаешь об этих занятиях? AB 1: соедини слова в предложения.
steps: 1) The children might clean up their neighbourhood, pick up litter, wash off graffiti from the walls and help elderly people.
2) The children are going to pick up litter by the river, help children in the local hospital, sew soft toys and collect books.
3) I think it is useful to pick up litter. It is important to help elderly and lonely people. It may be interesting to sew toys.
AB 1: Children will visit elderly and lonely people. Children will clean up flats and houses. Children will collect books for the hospital.
1-s38.answer: Волонтёрские дела: pick up litter, help elderly people, sew toys, collect books

2-s39.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 39. Посмотри на фото Пола (с. 42) и ответь: что сделают дети для этих людей?
steps: I think the children will do shopping, because it is difficult for elderly people. I think the children will clean up the garden. I think they will read books to the children in the hospital.
2-s39.answer: I think the children will … because …

3-s40.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 40. Дети разделились на три группы. К какой присоединишься ты и почему?
steps: I'd like to join the third group. We will help the children in the local hospital. I think we will collect books and toys and read stories to them. I like children and I want to make them happy.
3-s40.answer: I'd like to join the … group because …

4-s40.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 1, упр. 4, с. 40. Как ты помогаешь людям вокруг? Кому и что делаешь?
steps: We often help our granny. We water flowers in her garden. Sometimes we sweep the paths. I think it is very important to help elderly people. I also help my mum about the house.
4-s40.answer: We help … We water / sweep / clean …

5-s40.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 1, упр. 5, с. 40. Reader 1: статья о программе «Фермы для городских детей». AB 2: глаголы в три колонки.
steps: Reader 1.1: The authors of the programme are Michael and Clare Morpurgo. Michael was born in 1943. He is a writer. 1.2: Children spend a week on a farm, put on mackintoshes and wellington boots, milk cows, check sheep, feed pigs. 1.3: I would like to visit the farm. I want to learn how to milk cows.

AB 2: clean — cleaned — cleaned; bring — brought — brought; draw — drew — drawn; learn — learnt — learnt; do — did — done; win — won — won; go — went — gone; sew — sewed — sewn; sweep — swept — swept; sing — sang — sung; ride — rode — ridden.

1-s41.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 41. Интервью школьного репортёра с «Willing Helpers». 1) Какие вопросы он задаёт? 2) Что полезного сделали дети? 3) Прочитай правило Present Perfect.
steps: 1) Who have you helped? Can you tell the names of people that Willing Helpers have visited this month? What have you done?
2) This month the children have helped elderly and lonely people and the children in the local hospital. Alex has cleaned up Mrs Welsh's garden. Helen has sewn toys.
3) Present Perfect = have/has + V3: действие завершено, результат важен сейчас.
1-s41.answer: Вопросы репортёра; have helped / has cleaned / has sewn

2-s42.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 2, упр. 2, с. 42. 1) Что сделали дети — соедини предложения. 2) По списку дел скажи, что дети сделали, а что нет.
steps: 1) Mrs Welsh is very happy — her garden is clean: the children have cleaned it up. Mr Brown's flat is tidy: the children have tidied it.
2) Jay and Jane have swept the paths and cleaned up the house, but they haven't sewn toys. Helen and Ann have sewn toys, but they haven't collected books.

3-s43.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 2, упр. 3, с. 43. AB 1 (с. 33): составь опрос о том, как ты помогаешь людям.
steps: A: Masha, have you helped your grandma this week? — B: Yes, I have. — A: What have you done? — B: I have raked the leaves and watered the flowers.
A: Have you helped your neighbours? — B: No, I haven't.
3-s43.answer: Have you helped …? — Yes, I have. What have you done?

4-s43.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 2, упр. 4, с. 43. Составь предложения: что полезного сделали ты и твоя семья.
steps: I have swept the leaves in the garden. My mother has bought a new book for my brother. My brother has cleaned the flat. My father has repaired the fence. We have visited our grandparents.

5-s43.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 2, упр. 5, с. 43. Reader 2: стихотворения о медведе гризли и А. Милна. AB 2 (с. 35): ответь на вопросы.
steps: Reader 2.1: I have eaten blueberries. I have found ice-cold spring water. I have caught fish. 2.2: good. 2.3: b, b, a.
AB 2: Yes, I have visited my grandma this week. No, my mother hasn't cooked a meal yet. Yes, I have had a fair at school.
5-s43.answer: Reader: I have eaten / found; good; b, b, a; ответы с have / haven't

1-s44.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 44. Одноклассники Пола готовят концерт. 1) Что они предлагают? 2–3) Какая форма глагола используется? AB 1: переведи предложения.
steps: 1) The children suggest performing ballet dances and playing the violin.
2–3) The Present Perfect.
AB 1: Я сделал домашнюю работу. Я делаю домашнюю работу с пяти часов. Клэр играет на пианино уже три года.

2-s45.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 3, упр. 2, с. 45. Что умеют одноклассники Пола и как давно они это делают?
steps: Jack can do tricks. He has done tricks since he was 9.
Helen can sing folk songs. She has sung since she was 3.
Alex can play the violin. He has played the violin for five years.
Jay and Jane can dance. They have danced for four years.

3-s45.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 45. 1) Какие вопросы задать детям из другого класса? 2) Послушай и заполни таблицу. 3) Кто примет участие в концерте? AB 2: since / for.
steps: 1) How long have Jay and Jane performed folk dancing? How long has Alex played the violin? How long has Helen sung?
2) Ron — since he was 10; Jay and Jane — for 5 years; Alex — since she was 6; Helen — since she was 3; Jane and Nick — for 2 years.
3) I think Helen will take part because she can sing folk songs well. She has sung since she was 3.

AB 2.1: since ten o'clock; for six months; since Friday; for two years; since 2010. AB 2.2: Ben and Jim have been friends since 2008. Nat and Sandra have skated for a month. Jack has read the book since Monday.
3-s45.answer: How long have/has …? since + момент, for + период

4-s45.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 3, упр. 4, с. 45. Напиши, что ты хорошо умеешь делать и как давно.
steps: I can paint well. I have painted for 2 years. I can sing well. I have sung since I was 4. I can swim well. I have swum since I was six.
4-s45.answer: I can … well. I have … for / since …

5-s45.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 3, упр. 5, с. 45. AB 3 (с. 36): вставь глаголы в правильной форме (о школьном музее). AB 4: письмо другу о своих талантах.
steps: AB 3: The children have collected information for the school museum since 1987. The museum has worked for 17 years. The pupils have found a lot of old things. Visitors have come since 1990.

AB 4: Dear Misha, I'd like to tell you about myself. I can swim very well. I have swum since I was four. I go to the swimming pool three times a week. I have won two competitions. Write about your talents. Your friend, Sasha.
5-s45.answer: Present Perfect с since / for; письмо о талантах

1-s46.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 46. Пол и учитель говорят о подготовке к концерту. 1) Что уже сделано? 2–3) Найди маркеры Present Perfect. 4) Что дети уже сделали, а что нет? AB 1: составь предложения.
steps: 1) Jay has already sent the invitations. Alice and Polly have just sewn and brought the costumes.
2–3) yet — ещё (в вопросах и отрицаниях), already — уже, just — только что.
4) Paul has already made a programme. Everyone has already practised the dances and songs. Alice and Polly have already sewn the costumes. Ron hasn't prepared his costume yet.
AB 1: Polly has just performed her ballet dance. Ron hasn't prepared his costume yet. Have the children bought flowers yet?
1-s46.answer: already / just / yet с Present Perfect

2-s47.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 47. Концерт уже начался. Поговори о нём с другом (yet / already / just).
steps: Pupil 1: Have Jay and Jane performed folk dances yet? — Pupil 2: No, they haven't performed yet. — Pupil 1: Has Helen sung? — Pupil 2: Yes, she has just sung. — Pupil 1: Has Alex played the violin? — Pupil 2: Yes, he has already played.
2-s47.answer: Have … yet? — No, … haven't yet / Yes, … has just / already

3-s48.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 4, упр. 3, с. 48. Сыграй в игру «What have I done?».
steps: Have you played the violin yet? — No, I haven't played the violin yet.
Have you picked the pears yet? — Yes, I have already picked them.
Have you written the letter yet? — No, not yet.
3-s48.answer: Have you … yet? — Yes, I have already … / No, I haven't … yet

4-s48.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 4, упр. 4, с. 48. Reader 3: комикс о медведях (домашнее задание). AB 2 (с. 37): планы Пита в Британии — составь вопросы и ответы.
steps: Reader 3.1: — Have you done your homework? — No, I haven't done it yet. — And you, Woozy? — Yes, I've already done it. 3.2: Yes, my parents always ask me about my homework. 3.3: [ʌ] done, but; [əʊ] homework, no, go, won't; [uː] you, who, too, do; [ɪ] did, it.

AB 2: Have you seen Nelson's Column? — No, I haven't seen it yet. Have you watched animals in London Zoo? — Yes, I have already watched them. Have you sent a letter to your parents? — Yes, I have just sent it.
4-s48.answer: Комикс с already / yet; вопросы о планах Пита

next-lesson-is-a-reading-lesson-s48.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 4, Reading lesson, с. 48. Reader 4: отрывок из «Шпионка Гарриет» (Л. Фицью) о подготовке рождественского спектакля.
steps: 4.1: The extract may be about discoveries. 4.2: We were wrong — it is about the preparation for the Christmas show.
4.3: B, F, A, D, E, C. 4.4: they — children; she — the teacher; we — children; it — a play; that — things they eat at Christmas.
4.5: b, c, a, b, b. 4.6: Pinky — celery; Harriet — onion.
4.7: [eɪ] came, today, play; [æ] and, have; [ɑː] class, dance; [ɔː] all, talk.

next-lesson-is-a-reading-lesson-s48.answer: B, F, A, D, E, C; b, c, a, b, b; роли — сельдерей и лук

1-s49.answer: Новости: концерт и победа; What's the news? — Guess what!

3-s50.answer: How long have you …? What have you done?

4-s51.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 5, упр. 4, с. 51. Британские ученики приехали в ваш класс. Поговори с ними о хобби и новостях.

steps: Guess what! I have just read a new book. I have won a chess competition. My family has bought a puppy.

6-s51.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 5, упр. 6, с. 51. Reader 5: интервью с Уолли из книги «Где Уолли?» AB 1 (с. 38): выбери вопрос или ответ. AB 6 (с. 122): что ты сделал(а) в этом году.

ab1-s51.answer: have washed, have helped, have swept, have sewn + номера картинок

ab3-s51.condition: Unit 3, Consolidation, AB 3 (с. 41). Вставь глаголы из рамки в нужной форме.

ab3-s51.answer: hasn't learnt yet, has done for, has already cleaned, hasn't visited yet

ab4-s51.condition: Unit 3, Consolidation, AB 4 (с. 41). Найди 6 ошибок и исправь их.

vi-s54.condition: Unit 3, Test yourself VI, с. 54. Сколько новых слов вы узнали? Назови слова по группам: активности, досуг, помощь людям, концерт.

3-s57.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 57. AB 1.1–1.2 (с. 46–47): порядок слов в предложениях британских детей.

3-s66.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 66. AB 1 (с. 50): выбери правильное слово.
